LESSON: SARUFI 7.4.1 NGELI YA PA-KU-MU

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno
2. kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU.
4. Show that you can: kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno
2. kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
